name: Wallops Launch Pad 0 (MARS LP-0A and 0B)
tagline: Antares pad for Cygnus ISS cargo (2013-2023) and the Minotaur V launch of the LADEE Moon probe
description: Pad 0 is the launch complex at the southern tip of Wallops Island, Virginia, owned by the Virginia Spaceport Authority beside NASA's Wallops Flight Facility. Pad 0A was built for the Conestoga rocket, which flew once, on 23 October 1995, and self-destructed 46 seconds after liftoff. It was rebuilt for Antares, which launched from it 18 times between 21 April 2013 and 2 August 2023, mostly Cygnus cargo ships bound for the International Space Station: 17 successes and one failure, Orb-3 on 28 October 2014. The pad reopened with Cygnus OA-5 on 17 October 2016, and since August 2023 has been rebuilt for the Antares 330. Pad 0B, a few hundred metres to the south-west, has launched Minotaur rockets, most recently in June 2021. Its Minotaur V sent LADEE to the Moon on 7 September 2013, so far the only mission to another celestial body launched from Wallops. Launch azimuths of 38 to 60 degrees suit station orbits.
best_known_for: Antares pad for Cygnus ISS cargo (2013-2023) and the Minotaur V launch of the LADEE Moon probe
